**T-024 remains blocked for independent review.** I reproduced the Persian localization failure in the task-local preview: switching to `fa/rtl` changes the document direction, but the shell remains English. This is an **integration and contract-ownership issue**: the supplied T-019 client input is reported as verified, yet the current client has no catalog lookup wiring. The manager needs to supply a verified wired predecessor or assign and authorize the missing T-019 work.

The rendered-evidence guidance is partly stale. A later [review record](D:/Projects/Agentic/Agent-Trust-Ladder/.trust/manager/workspaces/T-024/.atl-evidence/ui-review/T-024-review-2026-10-29.md) contains the eight-cell matrix and dispositions that the earlier rejection found missing. It still marks general keyboard navigation, several provider-modal configurations, the English Plan Studio visual matrix, and generated Plan Studio cards **NOT OBSERVED**. It also records mobile task actions and modal focus containment as deferred failures. Those remain review gates; a downstream review does not replace the task-local observations.

In this session, I inspected current desktop light captures in both locales. The mixed-script task title and activity wrap visibly; the Persian shell localization fails. The new [English capture](D:/Projects/Agentic/Agent-Trust-Ladder/.trust/manager/workspaces/T-024/.atl-evidence/ui-review/capture-1793287532529-564f2f.png) and [Persian capture](D:/Projects/Agentic/Agent-Trust-Ladder/.trust/manager/workspaces/T-024/.atl-evidence/ui-review/capture-1793287548810-7fa2cc.png) are synthetic fixture evidence, not a full matrix or independent review. I made no source changes and preserved the existing workspace changes.

Both checks were rerun against the current workspace and exited successfully:

- `npm.cmd run ui:css:check` — `ALL OK: control-plane.html stylesheet matches runtime/scss source`
- `node verification/control_plane_server_test.mjs` — `PASS: control-plane server — reference shell, single controller, live snapshot and command bridge`

These results do not establish the missing rendered coverage or resolve localization. I did not record a completion observation or change ATL state. The next safe action is for the manager to resolve ownership of the missing catalog wiring; after that, recheck the affected Persian surfaces, complete the outstanding keyboard and component observations, rerun the required checks, and return the current revision for independent review. T-025 is listed as assigned, but I did not alter queue state or dispatch it.

issues.reason: NOT TRUSTWORTHY for the requested rendered UI scope. I inspected the current T-024 diff, review packet, and the actual synthetic browser preview at desktop 1280x800 in en/ltr light (capture .atl-evidence/ui-review/capture-1793264380407-473be8.png; asset hashes recorded in adjacent JSON). The page renders, but task-title and mixed-script activity content are visibly truncated at the right edge. The packet still records NOT OBSERVED for 7 of 8 locale/theme/viewport cells, provider modal, and keyboard-only navigation; Plan Studio was only snapshot-observed and task row behavior only partially observed. A theme toggle changed state, but no complete matrix or documented keyboard sequence was produced. The earlier fa/rtl observations report untranslated shell/Plan Studio copy and hidden mobile task actions; the metric fix is evidenced, but those findings are deferred without a complete recheck. The full review also exposes an integration discrepancy: T-019 completion checks require all static client literals to be catalog-routed, while the current client diff still contains English static literals and evidence says no catalog lookup; preserve/restore the verified T-019 behavior through authorized composition before claiming it. Rerun and record the required per-cell/surface results, inspect provider modal and keyboard path, disposition each FAIL, then rerun both required checks. Independence limits: my review context is separate from Rowan's builder session, but the Sage role contract reports routing configuration missing, so model-level independence cannot be established.
